# OneShotAiPanel

> Reusable AI assistant panel for React/Next.js + shadcn/ui: schema-validated JSON generation (Zod), real-time streaming (reasoning + response), side-by-side diff review (existing vs. proposed), and selective integration into your own project via onPlug. Distributed as a GitHub dependency, a shadcn GitHub source registry, a CLI installer, or vendored source.

[Full documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bn-dev-19/one-shot-ai-panel/main/README.md)

## Integration
- [Integration modes](https://github.com/bn-dev-19/one-shot-ai-panel/blob/main/README.md): GitHub dependency, shadcn registry (`npx shadcn add bn-dev-19/one-shot-ai-panel/<item>`), CLI installer (`pnpm exec one-shot-ai-panel install`), source copy of `src/module`.
- [CLI installer options](https://github.com/bn-dev-19/one-shot-ai-panel/blob/main/README.md): `--force`, `--no-install`, `--no-css`, `--no-registry`, `--pm`.
- [Integration by project type](https://github.com/bn-dev-19/one-shot-ai-panel/blob/main/README.md): Next.js / Vite + React, with or without shadcn.

## Usage
- [Panel usage example](https://github.com/bn-dev-19/one-shot-ai-panel/blob/main/README.md): `OneShotAiPanel` with `systemPrompt`, `files`, `tickets`, and `onPlug`.
- [Headless hook](https://github.com/bn-dev-19/one-shot-ai-panel/blob/main/README.md): `useAiPanel` + `buildSend` without the UI.

## Reference
- [OneShotAiPanel props](https://github.com/bn-dev-19/one-shot-ai-panel/blob/main/README.md): title, systemPrompt, initialUserPrompt, files, tickets, actionLabel, language, labels, onPlug, adapter, onSend, parser, invalidMode, showInfo*.
- [Response contract](https://github.com/bn-dev-19/one-shot-ai-panel/blob/main/README.md): JSON-only responses, one object per ticket, validated against `responseSchema` with Zod.
- [Change review](https://github.com/bn-dev-19/one-shot-ai-panel/blob/main/README.md): Identical / Modified / New / Removed statuses + "Diffs" side-by-side dialog, selective plug via `selectedKeys`.
- [Adapters](https://github.com/bn-dev-19/one-shot-ai-panel/blob/main/README.md): `opencode`, `shadcn`, `fallback` providers + `register()` for custom ones.
- [Internationalization](https://github.com/bn-dev-19/one-shot-ai-panel/blob/main/README.md): 6 locales (fr, en, ja, zh, es, ar) + per-string overrides via `labels`.
- [Exports](https://github.com/bn-dev-19/one-shot-ai-panel/blob/main/README.md): OneShotAiPanel, sections, useAiPanel, useStreaming, adapters, types, translations, AI_PANEL_PROJECT_LINKS.

## Source
- [Module entry](https://github.com/bn-dev-19/one-shot-ai-panel/blob/main/src/module/index.ts): package entry and re-export surface.
- [Repository structure](https://github.com/bn-dev-19/one-shot-ai-panel/blob/main/README.md): `src/module`, `src/primitives`, `scripts/install.mjs`, `themes/globals.css`, `primitives.json`.
